say:2:1511205001:0.text: You look like you've seen a ghost. What's wrong, Antandra?
say:2:1511205001:0.source_cn: 安丹，你的表情不对劲。出什么事了吗？

say:3:1511205002:0.text: There are... <style="highlight">echoes coming out of the Grimrift Vale</style>. They're becoming louder and louder.

say:7:1511205005:1.text: The elders fear the echoes may disturb the mind, so guards stand watch at the vale's entrance. Everyone is told <style="highlight">not to enter, not to investigate, and not to listen</style>.

choice_prompt:9:1511205006.text: The guards say the voices have been growing louder lately. And now... we can make out a little bit of what they're saying.
choice_prompt:9:1511205006.source_cn: 直到近些日，守卫传来报告，山谷内的回声正在逐渐增大，内容也终于可以被听清了。

say:10:1511205007:1.source_cn: 交战、咒骂……绝望的呼喊。那并不是现世的声音，它们所吐...

say:13:1511205009:0.text: I'm coming too! I've never been there, and if it's something bothering Antandra, then of course I can't just stand by and watch!
say:13:1511205009:0.source_cn: 我也去我也去，我还从没去过那里呢！既然是安丹德拉烦心的...

say:14:1511205010:1.text: *Sigh*... Alright. Now that you know, no use trying to talk you out of coming.
say:14:1511205010:1.source_cn: 你……唉，好吧。既然被你知道，就算劝也没用。
